sentences.text:
By way of filing the present appeal, tthe appellant-Insurance Insurance Company, is seeking recovery rights against respondent No. 2/driver and owner of the office vehicle bearing Registration No. HR-63-B-7052, 7052, to pay the amount of compensation of 1,84,141/ 1,84,141/- awarded to respondent No. 1-claimant claimant vide impugned Award dated 03.04.2015 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhiwani, in a claim petition bearing MACT Case No. 28 dated 20.03.2024 filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, 1988, on the grou ground that respondent No. 2 was not possessing a valid driving licence on the date of accident i.e. 06.05.2013 as he was not authorized to driive a Transport Vehicle. 06.05.2013,
2.

At the very outset, it is very fairly admitted by learned counsel for the appellant-Insurance appellant Company pany that the present appeal has been rendered infurctuous and may be disposed of, as such, in terms of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in M/s Bajaj Alliance General Insurance Co. Ltd. vs. Rambha Devi and others, Law Finder 1 of 2 FAO-5876 5876-2015 (O&M) -2- Doc ID# 2661595, wherein in it is held that a man holding the driving licence of Light Motor Vehicle (LMV), is also authorized to drive a 'Transport Vehicle' without any endorsement of Transport Vehicle upon the licence,, if the gross vehicle weight is within 7,500 kg.
